2105-4359-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4359-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4359-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

701-4490--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
701-4490--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
701-4490--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

222-527-955-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-955-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

147-4247-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-2292-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-5477.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

849-2511-2738-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-2557-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1497-2173-5220-7918.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-4142-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6139.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Caves of Chaos Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

4017-7399-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-7399-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1183-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-457-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
392-457-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1170-1171-7296.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-7296.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

252-4742-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4742-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1399-1606-1671-7223.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1409-4772-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-4659-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-6100--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Elvish Regrower.
When Elvish Regrower enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-6100--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

1115-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4050-5010-6650-7028.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4050-5010-6650-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1473-3484-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

2736-5147-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-2034-4679-4730.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1808-2099-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1808-2099-6291.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1029-5028-5840.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Nantuko Elder.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5840.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1055-5230-6498.description:
Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker, triggering it, causing the defending player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Consuming Aberration by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in opponents' graveyards, milling the remainder of their library.

222-527-5223-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-5223-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

864-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Eternal Witness each turn.
864-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

1430-2511-5011.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

628-5147-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5147-5490.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2792-2985-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Dokuchi Silencer does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-2985-3489.description:
Declare Dokuchi Silencer as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Dokuchi Silencer from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Dokuchi Silencer's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Dokuchi Silencer onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

38-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to any Goblin you control that does not have a cycling ability.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
38-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded three or more cards this turn, this combo nets infinite red mana.

1533-2051-2546-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1533-2051-2546-4067.description:
Activate Secluded Steppe's cycling ability by paying {W} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Secluded Steppe ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, creature or land.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Secluded Steppe and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2584-3629.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
1981-2584-3629.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with you being unable to lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Repeat from step 3.

565-2450-4705.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-2450-4705.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Harmonic Prodigy.
Orvar triggers twice and Harmonic Prodigy triggers once.
Resolve the Harmonic Prodigy trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Orvar triggers, creating two token copies of Harmonic Prodigy.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting any nonlegendary permanent you control that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Orvar triggers four times, and each Harmonic Prodigy triggers three times.
Resolve all Harmonic Prodigy triggers, giving each Harmonic Prodigy +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve all Orvar triggers, creating four copies of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate three of the copies of the mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 6.

539-2232-3652-4488.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Rampaging Baloths, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
